Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Note.name: Note
Note.comment: A note whose history is kept, with no review step.

fields.name: revisionsRevision
fields.description: The number of the instance's latest revision; absent before its first.

NoteRevisionsProposals.name: NoteRevisionsProposals
NoteRevisionsProposals.comment: On a table, one row per proposal on the row, keyed by its number: the merge patch, the note and the evidence it was proposed with, the revision it was made against, its state, and who settled it, when, why and the revision its approval made. A delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: noteRow
fields.description: The Note row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: proposal
fields.description: The proposal's number on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: patch
fields.description: The JSON merge patch of the row's own fields it proposes.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Why, for the reviewer.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: The rows it cites, as given.

fields.name: base
fields.description: The row's revision when it was proposed; absent before its first.

fields.name: state
fields.description: pending, approved or rejected.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller who proposed it.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was proposed, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: reviewedBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller who settled it.

fields.name: reviewedAt
fields.description: When it was settled, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was rejected, for the proposer.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: The revision its approval made, or the latest one when the row already had its patch.

NoteRevisionsRevisions.name: NoteRevisionsRevisions
NoteRevisionsRevisions.comment: On a table, one row per revision of the row, keyed by its number: the own fields as the change left them, who made it and when, and the proposal whose approval made it. A revision is never changed or removed while the row exists; a delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: note
fields.description: The Note row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: The revision's number on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The row's own fields as the change left them.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller whose change it records.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: proposal
fields.description: The proposal whose approval made it; absent for any other change.

Policy.name: Policy
Policy.comment:
A policy whose every change is kept (D16, D103's step 4): revision 1 at
its create and the next at each change of its own fields, and a change a
caller proposes waits for a reviewer who holds policies.review, whose
approval applies it through every rule an update meets.

fields.name: revisionsRevision
fields.description: The number of the instance's latest revision; absent before its first.
